title: Useless App
body:
I feel like I’ve been scammed. I canceled my subscription renewal but got charged again. 

I didn’t even use the application and cancelled the subscription forthwith, however, I still got charged again. Attempts to cancel subscription on the app didn’t work and emails to cancel and refund have not been replied. 

Complete scam! 

Can’t event rate with 0
author: kembzz
